actions.reasoning: RED FLAGS DETECTED: This email exhibits classic phishing characteristics: (1) Sender email 'security-alert@chase-notifications.net' is suspicious - legitimate Chase alerts come from @chase.com domains, not third-party notification services; (2) The email uses urgent language ('Immediate Action Required', 'please secure your account immediately') typical of phishing; (3) It requests clicking a link to 'Secure My Account' which is a common phishing tactic to capture credentials; (4) The link destination is unknown and not verified; (5) Legitimate banks typically direct users to log in directly to their official website, not through email links. This appears to be a phishing attempt impersonating Chase.
